verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw has a dedicated, first-party Data Protection & Privacy practice page. It advises on data governance, cybersecurity and privacy compliance, including the DPDP Act 2023, GDPR/CCPA alignment and breach response, and its TMC practice also covers data matters. Missing for 10: independent or third-party corroboration of the practice, and evidence of depth such as privacy-specific publications, named team members or representative matters.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: In our Data Protection & Privacy Practice, we advise clients on data governance, cybersecurity, and privacy compliance
covers DPDP Act 2023, GDPR/CCPA alignment and breach response
